title.en: Zero-vote sections in Brazil's presidential runoffs, 2018, 2022 and 2026

description.en: Counts of sections where a runoff candidate had no votes, model expectations, consistency checks and register categories, at national, regional and state level, with the research ledger they come from. No section, polling place or community is named.

provenance.method_en: Built by zero_vote_sections.ipynb, executed top to bottom by run_all.sh, from the TSE open-data files pinned in sources.lock.tsv. Every number is a row of results.csv. Derived from data of the Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (CC BY 4.0).
